question: In evidence.zip, Use all d20-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Find the final RS20 overlay. Read seed u8 at +4, the 4-byte key at +5, packed length u32be at +9, the CRC32 of the unpacked bytes u32le at +13, and packed bytes at +17. For each packed byte compute (byte SUB key[i % 4]) XOR seed XOR (i mod 251); verify the CRC32 and use the HCFG record at unpacked offset 0. Locate the unique CRC32-valid HCFG record: bytes 0..3 are ASCII HCFG, byte 4 is version, byte 5 is the XOR key, bytes 6..7 are the little-endian payload length, bytes 8..11 are the little-endian CRC32 of the decoded payload, and the payload begins at byte 12. XOR every payload byte with the one-byte key, verify CRC32, then parse the decoded UTF-8 JSON.
